{{Top|leg}}
'''Lab Module E''' was one of the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] modules of the [[Maw Installation]]. It was utilized for high security projects since it was connected to the [[Imperial Garrison (Maw Installation)|Imperial Garrison]] rather than [[The Hub (Maw Installation)|the Hub]]. Lab Module E was the where the [[Sun Crusher]] project was located.
